Model-written prose: the precision gate for LLM-assisted writing.

Terse checks prose that a model drafted and a person or agent edited. Model
drafts are grammatical, so any grammar finding here is a false alarm unless a
test labels it as a real error. Each file is unedited model output.

- haiku-*.md, sonnet-*.md, opus-*.md: written 2026-09-26 by fresh Claude Haiku,
  Sonnet, and Opus sessions with no Terse context, asked for common software
  documents (README, postmortem, design doc, PR description, migration guide,
  runbook, blog post, ADR, API guide, onboarding doc, launch post, security
  review) in their default style.
- gpt-*.md: the plugin-off arm of the 2026-08-26 Codex eval runs
  (gpt-5.6-sol, codex-cli 0.149.0) for the explainer, launch, and README cases.
